title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Reporting in, Doctor! Patrol completed. Nothing out of the ordinary!

title: Talk 1
original: I'm starving. That battle really took a lot out of me... You say you've got something to eat? Just for me? Whoa... It's… it's an apple pie! Thanks a lot! It looks great!

title: Talk 2
original: Everybody here at Rhodes Island calls me 'Tiny,' but it really doesn't bother me. The boys back on the force always teased me the same way. Hey! Don't pat my head! Or rub my ears! Or squeeze my cheek for that matter!

title: Talk 3
original: Doctor, I might not make it to training on Wednesdays or Fridays... Right, I need to be out there helping the civil corps to keep the peace and catch the bad guys! Wh-waht? I have an important mission on Friday?!

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Rhodes Island has lots of strong Operators, but there's no one who can match my speed!

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Time flies, Dcotor. We've been working together so long. I will never forget anything we've been through. But we can't stop now! We have to keep striving for that bright future, don't we?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: I just bumped into Skadi in the hallway... Doctor, you think she's cold and distant, don't you? She's actually very kind. Really!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Compared to everyone else, I'm pretty ordinary. I don't have any superpowers, or spectacular achievements to brag about... But I don't need magic or claws to make the world a better place. I can do that with my own two hands! But before that, we still have to eat well.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Doctor, you always worry so much about your people, but you never remember to take care of yourself. You can't do that! No matter what dangers you may face, I promise I'll be there to hold your hand! Definitely, you have my word!

title: Idle
original: Hmm? Why do you smell so good, Doctor? You're definitely hiding something tasty, aren't you?!

title: Onboard
original: Mounted Police Officer Grani, here to answer your call for help! Fear not. From this point forward, I will protect you!

title: Watching Battle Record
original: I see. That's another thing I should watch out for. Got it!

title: Promotion 1
original: An elite promotion medal? For me? Thank you, Doctor! I'll hang it up with my police medal!

title: Promotion 2
original: Since the day of my first mission, I've been leaning on this lance to get back on my feet. As long as I grip it tight, my heart will brim with the courage it needs to protect the people and their dreams.

title: Added to Squad
original: Shall I go scout the battlefield?

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: You're making me the captain? Okay. I'll protect the whole squad!

title: Depart
original: All right, let's bring home a victory!

title: Begin Operation
original: Your crimes stop here!

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Leave it to me!

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Sure!

title: Deployment 1
original: In position.

title: Deployment 2
original: Moving out!

title: In Battle 1
original: My lance will clear a path!

title: In Battle 2
original: Set! Ready! Charge on!

title: In Battle 3
original: Only one comes out on top when the lances are crossed!

title: In Battle 4
original: My battlefield extends well above the ground!

title: 4-star Result
original: If you look to harm those under my protection, you'll have to go through me first!

title: 3-star Result
original: Nice! That was an excellent fight! You all did splendidly!

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Doctor, please stay close to me. There may still be some enemies around.

title: Operation Failure
original: Damn it... I can't let myself fall here!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Anyone need help here?

title: Tap
original: Careful!

title: Trust Tap
original: If we get the chance, I hope we can see the world together, Doctor.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy New Year, Doctor! It's been another year, and the energy at Rhodes Island gives me the drive to do more things to benefit Terra. Can't do it on an empty stomach though. What are you guys having? Smells good.

title: Greeting
original: Hello, Doctor!

title: Birthday
original: Happy birthday, Doctor! I've tried this a few times with the other operators, and it's super fun! Come, get on my back. Ready? 3, 2, 1... go!

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: This lance has been with me for a long time. People say I don't use it to its full potential, but I only hope that justice is served wherever my lance can reach. I won't lose to anyone as long as I know I'm fighting for justice.
